remarks: Third floor/lobby level one bedroom deluxe Fractional ownership. This ownership gives you 10-11 weeks per year, or about 1 week per month on a rotating schedule. While lodging overnight, you have access to an underground parking garage, and owners can come and take advantage of the valet service year' round. Ownership includes year 'round access to the heated indoor/outdoor pool, 2 hot tubs, sauna, fitness center, private owner's lounge, and private locker rooms. Ellicottville living at a fraction of the cost!
